s0401.literal: Now the jade tablets and jade seals are complete; we request they be placed in the various chambers.
s0401.idiomatic: Now the jade tablets and jade seals are complete; we request they be placed in the various chambers.

s0402.literal: " The Emperor said: "The rite of personal offering is something the ancestors never performed; bring the tablets here, and I shall personally perform the offering.
s0402.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "The rite of personal offering is something the ancestors never performed; bring the tablets here, and I shall personally perform the offering.

s0403.literal: " He ordered offering officials to receive and escort them into the temple.
s0403.idiomatic: He ordered offering officials to receive and escort them into the temple.

s0404.literal: Arms were supplied to the southern-army troops patrolling for illicit salt in Jiang-Zhe and Henan.
s0404.idiomatic: Arms were supplied to the southern-army troops patrolling for illicit salt in Jiang-Zhe and Henan.

s0405.literal: On guichou day, because the northwest rebel prince was about to enter by way of Tubo, Dashiman, grand councillor for military and state affairs, was ordered to campaign against him; he was also instructed to have the convenient commander-in-chief dispatch a thousand troops to accompany him, subject to his command.
s0405.idiomatic: On guichou day, because the northwest rebel prince was about to enter by way of Tubo, Dashiman, grand councillor for military and state affairs, was ordered to campaign against him; he was also instructed to have the convenient commander-in-chief dispatch 1,000 troops to accompany him, subject to his command.

s0406.literal: On jiayin day Central Secretariat and Censorate officials said: "Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua reported irregularities in the surveillance system; we have discussed it and request that from now on, when surveillance censors and provincial surveillance commission officials investigate cases, county-prefecture officials shall be tried together with their route, route officials together with the pacification commission, and pacification commission officials together with the branch secretariat.
s0406.idiomatic: On jiayin day central secretariat and censorate officials said, "Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua reported irregularities in the surveillance system; we have discussed it and request that from now on, when surveillance censors and provincial surveillance commission officials investigate cases, county-prefecture officials shall be tried together with their route, route officials together with the pacification commission, and pacification commission officials together with the branch secretariat.

s0408.literal: " An edict directed that subjects of princes and imperial sons-in-law who had already been entered on military registers were not to be reclaimed by their original departments.
s0408.idiomatic: An edict directed that subjects of princes and imperial sons-in-law who had already been entered on military registers were not to be reclaimed by their original departments.

s0409.literal: On jiwei day twenty-nine thousand three hundred-odd ingots of notes were granted to impoverished guards of the various guards.
s0409.idiomatic: On jiwei day 29,300-odd ingots of notes were granted to impoverished guards of the various guards.

s0410.literal: On xinyou day Mercury transgressed Room.
s0410.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mercury transgressed Room.

s0411.literal: On renxu day Mercury transgressed Hooked Clasp.
s0411.idiomatic: On renxu day Mercury transgressed Hooked Clasp.

s0412.literal: On guihai day forty-eight thousand five hundred-odd ingots of notes were granted to the three departments of princes Basar, Huo'erhudasun, and Tula.
s0412.idiomatic: On guihai day 48,500-odd ingots of notes were granted to the three departments of princes Basar, Huo'erhudasun, and Tula.

s0413.literal: On dingmao day, because Bo'erchi, Dalachi, and others were impoverished, twenty-nine thousand-odd ingots of notes were granted.
s0413.idiomatic: On dingmao day, because Bo'erchi, Dalachi, and others were impoverished, 29,000-odd ingots of notes were granted.

s0414.literal: On wuchen day Venus appeared in daylight; the moon transgressed Room.
s0414.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus appeared in daylight; the moon transgressed Room.

s0415.literal: The Annam tributary envoys Chen Liyong and others were sent back to their country, and an edict was issued instructing Chen Rijun.
s0415.idiomatic: The Annam tributary envoys Chen Liyong and others were sent back to their country, and an edict was issued instructing Chen Rijun.

s0416.literal: Eleventh month, jiaxu day: Venus crossed the sky and transgressed Encampment.
s0416.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu day, Venus crossed the sky and transgressed Encampment.

s0417.literal: On xinsi day two inspector officials were added to the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, and the Jiang-Zhe gold-silver mining and smelting transport commission was established.
s0417.idiomatic: On xinsi day two inspector officials were added to the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, and the Jiang-Zhe gold-silver mining and smelting transport commission was established.

s0418.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Well.
s0418.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Well.

s0419.literal: On bingxu day Tuo Hangbangyu, elder brother of the Tanyang chieftain; Mishibadu, younger brother of the Fala chieftain; Tuo Hanghuxian, younger brother of the Arlu chieftain; and others each presented golden memorials and came to audience.
s0419.idiomatic: On bingxu day Tuo Hangbangyu, elder brother of the Tanyang chieftain; Mishibadu, younger brother of the Fala chieftain; Tuo Hanghuxian, younger brother of the Arlu chieftain; and others each presented golden memorials and came to audience.

s0420.literal: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0420.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0421.literal: On wuzi day a tiger tally was granted to the Arlu chieftain.
s0421.idiomatic: On wuzi day a tiger tally was granted to the Arlu chieftain.

s0422.literal: On guisi day armor, spear-shafts, bows and arrows, quivers, and other items totaling one hundred fifty-eight thousand two hundred-odd were granted to the Prince of Anxi.
s0422.idiomatic: On guisi day armor, spear-shafts, bows and arrows, quivers, and other items totaling 158,200-odd were granted to the Prince of Anxi.

s0423.literal: On wuxu day Ningdu and Huichang counties of Ganzhou Route were promoted to prefectures; Shicheng County was attached to Ningdu, and Ruijin County to Huichang.
s0423.idiomatic: On wuxu day Ningdu and Huichang counties of Ganzhou Route were promoted to prefectures; Shicheng County was attached to Ningdu, and Ruijin County to Huichang.

s0424.literal: An edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to register concealed and omitted official fields and investigate powerful households evading corvée.
s0424.idiomatic: An edict directed the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat to register concealed and omitted official fields and investigate powerful households evading corvée.

s0425.literal: Twelfth month, gengzi new moon: Academician Alihunsali and others were dispatched to offer sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy.
s0425.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengzi new moon, Academician Alihunsali and others were dispatched to offer sacrifice to the stars at the Bureau of Astronomy.

s0426.literal: On guimao day, because subjects under imperial son-in-law Abuhua were impoverished, ten thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0426.idiomatic: On guimao day, because subjects under imperial son-in-law Abuhua were impoverished, 10,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0427.literal: Gold of two hundred fifty taels each and five hundred ingots of notes each were granted to princes Yahutu, Hulachu, Ashihan, and others.
s0427.idiomatic: Gold of 250 taels each and 500 ingots of notes each were granted to princes Yahutu, Hulachu, Ashihan, and others.

s0428.literal: On bingchen day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.
s0428.idiomatic: On bingchen day the moon transgressed Xuanyuan.

s0429.literal: The Jingnan monk Puzhao and others forged Buddhist texts containing treasonous language and were executed.
s0429.idiomatic: The Jingnan monk Puzhao and others forged Buddhist texts containing treasonous language and were executed.

s0430.literal: On jiwei day an edict to Dadu Route directed that for all government hire, government purchase, and every corvée service, households of various categories and common people should share the burden equally.
s0430.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict to Dadu Route directed that for all government hire, government purchase, and every corvée service, households of various categories and common people should share the burden equally.

s0431.literal: Gold of five hundred taels each, silver of five thousand taels each, two thousand ingots of notes each, and two hundred bolts of silk each were granted to princes Buyan Tiemu'er and Aba Ye Bugan; the junior princes received one-fifth less.
s0431.idiomatic: Gold of 500 taels each, silver of 5,000 taels each, 2,000 ingots of notes each, and 200 bolts of silk each were granted to princes Buyan Tiemu'er and Aba Ye Bugan; the junior princes received one-fifth less.

s0432.literal: Because each route's surveillance commission had eight officials with one seal each, an order directed that three be collected.
s0432.idiomatic: Because each route's surveillance commission had eight officials with one seal each, an order directed that three be collected.

s0433.literal: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Celestial River.
s0433.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Celestial River.

s0434.literal: A double-dragon-knob jade seal was granted to the Imperial Preceptor.
s0434.idiomatic: A double-dragon-knob jade seal was granted to the Imperial Preceptor.

s0435.literal: Because Yesudai'er's army had left Shandong on account of Li Tan's rebellion, the places where they had originally been garrisoned had been cultivated by others; over the years they had become established holdings, and lawsuits never ceased;
s0435.idiomatic: Because Yesudai'er's army had left Shandong on account of Li Tan's rebellion, the places where they had originally been garrisoned had been cultivated by others; over the years they had become established holdings, and lawsuits never ceased;

s0436.literal: An order directed that other wasteland within the territory be granted them — five qing to regular soldiers, two qing to surplus males; those who already had their allotment were not granted more.
s0436.idiomatic: An order directed that other wasteland within the territory be granted them — five qing to regular soldiers, two qing to surplus males; those who already had their allotment were not granted more.

s0437.literal: Sea-transport porterage was reduced by one ingot of notes, making six ingots five hundred cash per shi; this was established as regulation.
s0437.idiomatic: Sea-transport porterage was reduced by one ingot of notes, making six ingots five hundred cash per shi; this was established as regulation.

s0438.literal: The Qiliqisi people dwelling at Jinshan and others were relocated to Shandong; fields, cattle, and seed were granted them.
s0438.idiomatic: The Qiliqisi people dwelling at Jinshan and others were relocated to Shandong; fields, cattle, and seed were granted them.

s0439.literal: On dingmao day princes were forbidden to summon government officials at will.
s0439.idiomatic: On dingmao day princes were forbidden to summon government officials at will.

s0440.literal: On jisi day an edict exempted armorers and artisans from household corvée.
s0440.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict exempted armorers and artisans from household corvée.

s0441.literal: That year, thirty persons were sentenced to death.
s0441.idiomatic: That year, 30 persons were sentenced to death.
